name: Transcription Skill
description: Speech recognition: audio/video in, structured Transcript (segments, optional word timestamps, language, provenance) and SpeechEvent candidates out. Not an agent, not a subtitle renderer, not a media analyzer.

tools.name: transcription/transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file into a validated Transcript.

input.word_segmentation: engine | dictionary (dictionary: language ja and word_timestamps true; needs the optional [ja] extra)
input.speaker_turns: diarization-skill/turns@1 document | path | null (merged after recognition, never cached)
input.chunk_seconds: 30..3600 | null (chunked long recording, cut at pauses; needs language)
input.parallel: 1..8 (chunks recognized at a time; chunk_seconds only)
input.speech_regions: media-analysis-skill speech_regions response | result | observation | path | null (chunk_seconds only)
input.domain_vocabulary: {programme: str | list[str], slides: slide-sync/deck@1 document | path | list[str], speakers: list[str], terms: list[str], max_terms: 1..200 (default 50), japanese: bool (default false)} | null (terms passed as the engine's initial_prompt or custom vocabulary; recorded in provenance.vocabulary)
input.corrections: list[{from: str, to: str, match: word | substring (default word)}] | {from: to} | null (applied to segment text after recognition; every replacement in provenance.corrections.applied with its time)
input.script_text: str | null (a known script, one line per sentence or cue, aligned to the audio instead of recognised: engine with the script_alignment capability (stable_ts), language required; the transcript has alignment.source 'aligned', segments[].script_line, and every script line and word that could not be placed under alignment, never timed)

tools.name: transcription/segments
tools.description: Derive SpeechEvent-compatible candidates from a Transcript (one per segment, optional gap merge).

tools.name: transcription/export
tools.description: Render a Transcript as json, srt, vtt, tsv or txt (plain timed text, no styling).

tools.name: transcription/speakers
tools.description: Fill segments[].speaker_id (and words[].speaker_id) of a Transcript from diarization-skill speaker turns (diarization-skill/turns@1), with diarization-skill's own ASSIGN rule. No diarization here. Follows diarization-skill's speaker-id assignment rule and passes its conformance fixtures at the version in `rule`.

tools.name: transcription/find
tools.description: Find a phrase in one or more Transcripts: every hit with its start and end, segment ids, word indices, speaker_id and neighbouring text. Exact, then normalized matching (NFKC width folding, casefold, long vowel marks, whitespace and punctuation ignored, across word and segment boundaries), then optional approximate matching labelled with its ratio. A read-only query: no margin, no cut range, no ranking.

input.fuzzy: 0.5..1.0 | null (approximate matches with ratio >= fuzzy; phrase of at most 64 characters after folding)

output.hits: list[{source, transcript_id, match: exact|normalized|approximate, ratio, start, end, timing: word|segment, segment_ids, word_indices (null when segment-timed), speaker_id, speaker_ids, text, segment_text, context: {before, after}}] (time order within each transcript, transcripts in the order given; empty when the phrase is not spoken)
output.transcripts: list[{source, transcript_id, language, segments, words, word_timed, hits}]

tools.name: transcription/select
tools.description: Turn a selection of words and sentences (word index ranges and / or segment ids, to remove or to keep) into the time spans that would be removed, each with the window its in and out edges may use: the gap to the kept speech before and after it, found by time. Also the sentences touched, their speakers and the seconds of speech. A kept word that overlaps removed speech is refused (selection_overlaps_kept_speech) unless overlap is include. A read-only query: no margin, no cut (video-editing-skill ripple places the cuts).

rule.selection: word index ranges [[first, last], ...] (inclusive) and / or segment ids; their union. Never seconds
rule.units: the words of each segment that has words, the segment itself where words is null (named by its id only)
rule.keep: every unit not selected is removed, and the time before the first kept unit and after the last one
rule.spans: removed units with no kept unit starting between them, in time order; start / end: the speech they cover
rule.windows: in: [end of the kept speech before, the span's start] (0 when none); out: [the span's end, start of the kept speech after] (the duration when none); neighbours by time, not by index
rule.overlap: a kept unit overlapping a removed span: refuse (selection_overlaps_kept_speech) or include (removed too, listed)
rule.applies: nothing: no margin, no cut, no change to the transcript; video-editing-skill ripple places the cuts

input.segments: list[segment id] | null (whole segments; at least one of words / segments)

output.counts: {units, words, removed_units, removed_words, kept_units, spans, sentences_whole, sentences_part}
output.most_seconds: seconds the widest cuts would remove
output.spans: list[{id, start, end, in: {lo, hi, after_kept}, out: {lo, hi, before_kept}, word_ranges, units, segment_ids, speaker_ids, text, speech_seconds, most_seconds}] (time order)
output.sentences: list[{segment_id, speaker_id, start, end, text, removed: whole | part, removed_text, removed_units, units, speech_seconds}]
output.included_by_overlap: list[{word_index, segment_id, text, start, end, speaker_id}]

tools.name: transcription/check
tools.description: Validate a Transcript document against the contract.

tools.name: transcription/microphones
tools.description: One transcript per microphone: 2..8 microphone tracks of one recording (one person per microphone), each transcribed on its own with word timestamps through transcription/transcribe, merged by time into one Transcript whose speaker_id is the microphone's name (no diarization). A word recognized on one microphone is dropped as cross-talk when another microphone is louder by at least crosstalk_margin_db over the word's span and recognized a word there; otherwise it is kept, so two people talking at once are both kept. Recorded under microphone_merge.

rule.crosstalk: drop a word when another microphone is louder by >= crosstalk_margin_db (RMS dBFS over the word's span) and recognized an overlapping word

input.microphones: list[{input: path, name: str | null (default MIC_01, MIC_02, ...), audio_stream: int >= 0 | null}] (2..8)
every transcription/transcribe input except input, audio_stream, speaker_turns, dry_run, speech_regions (shared by all microphones; word_timestamps is always true); the files must agree in length within 0.5 s

side_effects: writes cache under workspace, once per microphone

tools.name: transcription/batch
tools.description: Run many transcription/transcribe requests in one process. One item's failure does not abort the others; each result is reported independently in order.

output.results: list[{ok: bool, result: transcription/transcribe output} | {ok: bool, error: {code, message, details}}]

side_effects: writes cache under workspace, once per item
